Approach

My all-encompassing approach and checklist that builds impactful brand outcomes.

My all-encompassing approach and checklist that builds impactful brand outcomes.

1.

User Research

I conduct thorough research, using methods like interviews, surveys, and analytics to gather qualitative and quantitative data. This guides design decisions, ensuring the final output.

2.

Prototyping & User Testing

I create interactive prototypes, facilitating user feedback through usability testing and iterative refinement for a user-friendly and intuitive product.

3.

User-Centered Design

I apply User-Centered Design principles, involving users from ideation to validation to ensure a positive and seamless experience throughout the process.

4.

Responsive & Accessible

I prioritize responsive and accessible design, ensuring the digital product is user-friendly across devices and abilities. This approach enhances the overall user experience.
